integrity: Exact symbolic proof with 24 non-plane shape certificate and independent exhaustive labeled-tree generator; no independent external validation.
scientific_limitations: Unit-edge rooted full binary trees with equal independent extinction risk and only one fully protected taxon; excludes heterogeneous branch lengths, clocks, ecological interactions, multiple interventions and empirical prediction. Historical novelty is provisional where inaccessible literature could contain a stronger shape theorem.
title: Eight taxa are the sharp cutoff for extinction-risk-dependent single-species phylogenetic rescue
